# Wolfsblvt Works website licensing

The Wolfsblvt Works website uses component-specific terms. No single licence applies to every file in this repository.

- The website's code (Astro components and pages, browser scripts, styles, the Worker, the contact service, build scripts and tests) is licensed under [GNU AGPL-3.0-only](LICENSES/AGPL-3.0-only.txt).
- Original prose (the site's copy, the Pile's entries, the documentation) is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
- The Wolfsblvt Works marks, Yoru and other artwork are reserved and not covered by either licence.
- Third-party fonts, icon data and dependencies keep their own licences and notices.

The authoritative path-by-path map is [LICENSES/README.md](LICENSES/README.md).
